name: AI Product Generator for WooCommerce – AI Descriptions, Images, SEO & Bulk Content
author: Jcodex

sections.description:
AI Product Generator for WooCommerce is the fastest way to generate product descriptions, product images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, FAQs, and more — directly inside the WooCommerce product editor. No API key required. No external tools. No copy-pasting.

If you run a WooCommerce store, a dropshipping business, a print-on-demand shop, or manage client stores as an agency, this plugin cuts your product listing time from hours to seconds.

🚀 Why Store Owners Choose This Plugin

Most WooCommerce stores waste hours writing product descriptions manually — or worse, copy-paste from suppliers and get penalized by Google for duplicate content. This plugin solves that instantly.

✅ No API key needed — unlike most AI content plugins, you don’t need an OpenAI account or any third-party setup. Just install and generate.
✅ Works inside WooCommerce — the AI generator panel appears right inside the product editor. No tab switching, no copy-pasting.
✅ One click, ready to publish — descriptions auto-fill the content field, images auto-set as the featured image.
✅ Built for scale — generate content for individual products or your entire catalog in bulk (Pro).
✅ SEO-optimized output — every description is structured to rank, not just fill space.

🆓 Free Version Features

AI Content Generation
– AI product description generation (free trial — 10 generations)
– AI short description generation (free trial — 10 generations)
– AI product image generation (free trial — 10 images)
– Product features list generator
– Product benefits list generator
– Product tags generator
– Basic SEO title generator
– Basic meta description generator
– Product name improvement suggestions

WooCommerce Integration
– AI panel built directly inside the WooCommerce product editor
– Supports Classic Editor
– Supports Block Editor (Gutenberg)
– Auto-fills product description field
– Auto-fills short description field
– Auto-sets generated image as featured image
– Saves images to WordPress Media Library

No API key required to get started. Test the full workflow on a real product for free.

💎 Pro Version Features

Everything in Free, plus:

Unlimited Content Generation
– Unlimited AI product descriptions
– Unlimited AI short descriptions
– Custom prompt templates
– Multiple writing styles: Professional, Friendly, Luxury, Technical, Sales-Focused
– Tone selection: Formal, Casual, Persuasive, Premium
– Description length control: Short, Medium, Long

Advanced SEO Optimization
– Unlimited SEO title generation
– Unlimited meta description generation
– Focus keyword suggestions
– Long-tail keyword suggestions
– Product SEO audit score (e.g. SEO Score: 87/100 — Missing FAQ, Description Too Short)
– SEO optimization recommendations

WooCommerce Product Optimization
– AI product attributes generator (Material, Size, Weight, Color — auto-creates WooCommerce attributes)
– AI product FAQ generator (FAQ Schema ready)
– AI product specifications generator (Weight, Dimensions, Connectivity, Battery Life)
– AI product comparison table generator (great for affiliate and electronics stores)

Bulk Content Generation
– One-click generate everything: Description, Short Description, SEO Title, Meta Description, Tags, Features, Benefits, FAQ — all with one button
– Bulk optimization for selected products, entire catalog, or product categories
– Bulk AI image generation across multiple products

AI Image Features
– AI lifestyle image generator: product in office, home, outdoor, and in-use scenarios
– AI product mockup generator: T-shirts, mugs, bottles, phone cases
– Background removal — convert product photos to transparent PNG
– Image upscaling — improve low-resolution product images

Marketing Content Generator
– AI marketing copy: Facebook Ads, Instagram Posts, Google Ads, Pinterest Descriptions
– AI email marketing content: product launch emails, promotional emails, sales campaigns
– AI video script generator: TikTok scripts, Instagram Reel scripts, YouTube Shorts scripts

Product Import & Rewrite Tools
– Import product from URL (Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy, supplier websites) and generate unique content automatically
– Rewrite existing content: improve SEO, humanize, expand, shorten, or make more persuasive

Multilingual Content Generation
– Generate content in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Urdu
– WPML compatible
– Polylang compatible

Agency & Team Features
– CSV export of AI-generated content
– CSV import
– Client site management — manage multiple WooCommerce stores from one place

👉 Upgrade to Pro: https://jcodex.com/plugins/jcodex-ai-product-generator-for-woocommerce/

Who This Plugin Is Built For

  • WooCommerce store owners who add products regularly and want to stop writing descriptions manually
  • Dropshipping businesses that import large product catalogs and need unique content fast
  • Print-on-demand stores with hundreds of products that all need individual copy
  • eCommerce SEO agencies managing multiple WooCommerce client stores
  • Amazon/AliExpress importers who need to rewrite supplier content to avoid duplicate content penalties
  • Online retailers who want better Google rankings without hiring a copywriter

How It Works

  1. Open any product in WooCommerce
  2. Find the AI Product Generator panel inside the product editor
  3. Click Generate Description or Generate Image
  4. The content is auto-filled into the correct fields
  5. Review, edit if needed, then click Publish or Update

The plugin connects to the JCodex API, which handles all AI processing. You do not need an OpenAI account, a Stability AI account, or any external API key. Everything is managed for you.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JCodex API (https://jcodex.com/wp-json/apg/v1) to process AI generation requests. Requests are only sent when a logged-in admin or editor clicks generate inside the WooCommerce product editor.

Data sent: your site’s public URL and the generation prompt built from your product content.

  • JCodex Terms of Use: https://jcodex.com/terms/
  • JCodex Privacy Policy: https://jcodex.com/privacy/

JCodex may use OpenAI and Stability AI on its backend infrastructure. Their policies apply to prompt processing:
– OpenAI Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
– Stability AI Terms: https://stability.ai/terms-of-use

No customer personal data is collected or transmitted.

Plugin Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce (must be installed and active)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Search for AI Product Generator for WooCommerce and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate after installation.
  5. Open any product under Products > Add New or edit an existing product.
  6. Find the AI Product Generator panel near the top of the product editor.
  7. Click generate for a description or image — content appears instantly.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

No. This plugin connects to the JCodex API, which handles all AI processing. You do not need an OpenAI account, a Stability AI account, or any third-party API key to get started.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. The AI generator panel only appears on WooCommerce product edit pages.

Is there a free version?

Yes. The free version includes 10 AI product description generations, 10 short description generations, 10 product image generations, and 10 SEO title generations — enough to test the complete workflow on real products before deciding to upgrade.

What happens after I use my free generations?

The plugin will prompt you to upgrade to Pro. All existing generated content stays in place — nothing is removed. You simply need to upgrade to generate content for additional products.

How do I generate content for my entire product catalog?

Upgrade to Pro, which includes bulk product optimization. You can generate descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, and FAQs for your entire catalog — or for selected products or categories — in one batch operation.

Can I control the writing style and tone?

Yes, in the Pro version. You can choose from writing styles including Professional, Friendly, Luxury, Technical, and Sales-Focused, and tones including Formal, Casual, Persuasive, and Premium.

Does this plugin support multilingual content?

Yes. The Pro version generates content in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, and Urdu, and is compatible with WPML and Polylang.

Where are generated images saved?

Generated images are automatically saved to your WordPress Media Library and set as the product featured image. You can manage them like any other media file.

Will this plugin affect my store’s speed or frontend performance?

No. The AI generator only makes API calls when you manually trigger a generation inside the product editor. It has no frontend code and does not affect your store’s performance for customers.

Does it work with the Block Editor and Classic Editor?

Yes. The AI panel works with both the Gutenberg Block Editor and the Classic Editor.

Can I edit the generated content before publishing?

Yes. All generated content is inserted into the product fields but nothing is saved until you click Update or Publish. You can edit or discard any generated content before saving.

Does this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. The plugin operates inside the WooCommerce product editor and is compatible with all standard WooCommerce themes.

Is this plugin GDPR friendly?

The plugin only transmits product content data (your site URL and generation prompts). No customer personal data is collected or transmitted. Please review the JCodex Privacy Policy and third-party AI provider policies for full details.

Can I import products from Amazon or AliExpress and rewrite the content?

Yes, in the Pro version. You can import a product URL from Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy, or any supplier site, and the plugin will generate unique, SEO-optimized content automatically.

Can I generate marketing copy for social media and email campaigns?

Yes, in the Pro version. The marketing tools generate Facebook Ads, Instagram Posts, Google Ads, product launch emails, promotional emails, TikTok scripts, and more.
